# v1.21.2b1 — Dispatch stop isolation (beta)

This development beta is based on v1.21.1. It includes that release's dispatch
lifecycle, write reliability and dashboard-management changes, plus the fixes below.
For upgrades from an older version, also review the
[v1.21.1 behavior changes](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp/releases/tag/v1.21.1).

## Fixed

- Turning off an inactive dispatch switch no longer resets a different local
  controller's running session. This prevents repeated start/stop cleanup sequences
  from erasing an active command and causing its next parameter update to report
  a read-back conflict.
- The requested switch still clears its own local state and callbacks. The active
  controller's session and deadline remain intact.
- Conflict errors now include the observed register block and expected command
  arrays in the existing logs, service error and switch fault attribute.

## Preserved behavior

- Stopping the active controller and explicit stops with no local session retain
  their existing behavior. Dispatch Reset remains the explicit global stop.
- Reset register values and verification are unchanged. The stop fix suppresses
  unintended reset writes; the diagnostics add no Modbus reads or writes.
- Read-back conflict protection remains in place. A conflicting power/SoC update
  still raises a service error and suspends that session.
- No PredBat dependency or automation changes are required.

## Validation and limitations

400 Python tests passed in each of three compatibility environments covering
HA 2024.12.5 and 2026.10.4, with pymodbus 3.7.4 and 3.16.1. The release workflow
also checks Python tests, 23 frontend tests, HACS metadata and hassfest before publishing.

Coverage includes all dispatch-controller pairs, active-controller stops,
paused Excess Export/Peak Shaving sessions, repeated charging/discharging updates,
Mode 1/19 holds, queued stop/start ordering and conflict diagnostics.
These checks simulate Modbus and do not establish hardware validation.

Stop an active dispatch before changing Dispatch Mode. Active-session mode
selection remains a separate limitation inherited from v1.21.1.

## Installation

Take a backup first. In HACS, open AlphaESS Modbus TCP, use the three-dot menu's
**Redownload** option, and select **v1.21.2b1** under **Need a different version?**.
Restart Home Assistant afterward. Update during an idle dispatch period: a restart
does not automatically reset the inverter or resume an existing local controller.

Validate a complete charge window, including repeated power/SoC updates,
periodic caller refreshes, Hold/Freeze transitions and return to normal operation.
Watch for `dispatch_suspended` or a `read-back differs` error. If a conflict occurs,
retain its `observed=` and `expected=` arrays for diagnosis.

To roll back, select the previously installed version in HACS and restart Home
Assistant. Publishing this beta does not update an existing HA installation.
